content.short: Cute slime collectibles on the Cardano blockchain!
content.description:
Ada Slimes is an NFT project of cute slimes on the Cardano blockchain.

There are many different slimes you can collect, and each one is unique! Each slime has a unique set of traits - and sometimes accessories - that no other slime has!

There are 1,260 slimes available in our 1st series, and 1,920 slimes in our 2nd series!
